tips.text: Throw Duskbringer down a lane or at a camp, then run along the trail for extra Move Speed and Attack Damage. It also closes distance out of combat.
Hit an enemy champion with Duskbringer so they leave a trail you can follow. The trail shows where they walk, even in fog.
Keep attacking monsters and champions so Umbra Blades comes back quickly. Each empowered hit heals you and damages everything around the target.
Stay close to your target with Unspeakable Horror. If they run out of range, the tether breaks and the fear never lands.
Run straight at feared enemies. Unspeakable Horror gives you a big Move Speed boost toward them.
Hold Shroud of Darkness for the enemy's key stun or hook. Blocking an ability doubles your Attack Speed bonus for a few seconds.
Cast Shroud of Darkness just before you recast Paranoia. Enemies may waste a disable on the shield, and it keeps refreshing during the dash.
Use Paranoia to gank across the map. The dash tracks its target until you arrive, and the enemies see less and lose sight of their allies.
Do not recast Paranoia while rooted. Cast it first, then dash once you are free.
Hold Shroud of Darkness for The Darkin Blade or Infernal Chains; blocking one gives you a big Attack Speed boost for the trade.
Use Paranoia's dash from outside his sight, then fight him once you land; the shield from Shroud of Darkness can cover you when you arrive.
Aim Duskbringer down a long line to catch him; the trail it leaves on him shows you where he is and speeds you up.
Cast Unspeakable Horror and stay close so the tether is not broken; Aatrox's Umbral Dash can pull him out of range, so cast it when his dash is spent.
Avoid long fights when Aatrox has healing from his passive; burst him with Paranoia and leave before he sustains.
Hold Shroud of Darkness for Ambessa's Public Execution; it is blocked by a spell shield, and she loses her big engage.
Shroud of Darkness also blocks Cunning Sweep, so time it as she commits to her combo and gain Attack Speed.
Use Unspeakable Horror on her and keep the tether unbroken; if she walks out of range, you lose the fear, so cut off her escape routes.
Use Paranoia in a skirmish to dash onto Ambessa if she is alone, since the dash cannot be stopped by crowd control.
Keep fighting inside the Dusk Trail from Duskbringer; you move faster and hit harder, which helps you win a short brawl.
Press Shroud of Darkness when Amumu is about to throw Bandage Toss; it blocks the stun and speeds up your attacks.
Duskbringer can be blocked by a spell shield, so aim it so it hits Amumu before he can answer.
Don't clump with your team when Amumu has Curse of the Sad Mummy ready; one ultimate can stun everyone at once.
Use Unspeakable Horror on Amumu only once his Bandage Toss is spent, so he can't easily stun you out of the tether.
Hold Shroud of Darkness for Above and Below; blocking it denies the knock up and gives you extra Attack Speed for the fight.
Use Unspeakable Horror on Bel'Veth and keep the tether unbroken. She can dash out in any direction that is off cooldown, so stay close to her.
Fight her when she has no Void Coral and few kills. Her attack speed and true damage grow each time she takes a champion down.
Use Paranoia to dash onto her when she has used her dashes. Her Royal Maelstrom cannot stop it, and her Above and Below cannot knock you away.
Hold Shroud of Darkness for Brand's Sear or Pillar of Flame; blocking one wastes the start of his combo and speeds up your attacks.
Cast Paranoia, then use Shroud of Darkness during the dash. Brand's spells can't touch you when you land.
Brand is fragile and has no escape. Dash onto him with Paranoia once his key spells are on cooldown.
Use Duskbringer to close distance in the fog. Its trail speeds you up and you can chase him down.
Use Unspeakable Horror when you are on him. If you stay attached, he is feared and can't cast.
Avoid grouping with allies when Brand has burned someone. His Ablaze explosion and Conflagration hit nearby units.
Hold Shroud of Darkness for Briar's Head Rush; it blocks the stun and the damage, and Nocturne attacks much faster afterward.
Block Certain Death's dash with Shroud of Darkness too, since the spell shield stops that ability.
Stay close to your team when Briar kicks Certain Death; nearby enemies are feared on landing, so don't stand alone.
Hit Briar with Unspeakable Horror and stay on her; if the tether holds, she is feared and you chase her fast.
Throw Duskbringer at Briar to open a fight; the trail gives you speed and damage while you stay on it.
Her Chilling Scream is a projectile, so Shroud of Darkness can also block a fully charged scream and its wall stun.
Hold Shroud of Darkness for Darius' Apprehend; blocking the pull stops his combo and speeds up your attacks.
Shroud of Darkness also blocks Noxian Guillotine, so time it when Darius is low on you and about to finish.
Hit Darius with Duskbringer from long range; he has no way to close the gap quickly except Apprehend.
Use Unspeakable Horror and keep him tethered; if he is feared, chase him down at high speed.
Avoid long fights with Darius; his bleeds build up. Trade quickly and leave.
Use Paranoia to dash onto Darius when you can finish him off.
Hold Shroud of Darkness for Diana's Crescent Strike or Lunar Rush; blocking one boosts your Attack Speed.
Use Paranoia's dash on Diana after she spends her abilities; her dash cannot save her from it.
Cast Shroud of Darkness just before Diana's Moonfall pull lands; it blocks the pull and her beam.
Fight Diana while she has no Pale Cascade shield, or wait until the orbs are gone.
Use Unspeakable Horror on Diana and stay close so the tether holds and she is feared.
Save Shroud of Darkness for Dr. Mundo's Infected Bonesaw; it blocks the hit, and you get faster attacks.
Don't rely on Unspeakable Horror to fear Dr. Mundo; his passive resists the first disable, so use it only after that is spent.
Burst him quickly; if the fight drags out, Maximum Dosage and Heart Zapper heal him through your damage.
Use Duskbringer to dodge in and out of his range; his Infected Bonesaw is easy to sidestep, so keep your distance.
Cast Shroud of Darkness just as Ekko's Parallel Convergence or Timewinder lands; it blocks the next enemy ability and speeds up your attacks.
Use Paranoia to dash onto Ekko when his Chronobreak is down. He has little left to escape with.
Hit Ekko with Unspeakable Horror and stay on him so the tether holds. If it holds, he is feared and cannot fight back.
Throw Duskbringer at Ekko to chase him. The trail gives you speed and attack damage while you follow.
Spend Shroud of Darkness before you dash with Paranoia, so a stun or burst cannot stop your attack.
Walk away from Evelynn when her Allure mark shows on you, and stay near allies so she can't reach you alone.
Cast Shroud of Darkness when Evelynn's mark is about to expunge. It blocks her ability and gives you extra Attack Speed.
Don't fight Evelynn at low health; Last Caress hits much harder on weak targets.
Use Duskbringer to chase Evelynn and leave a trail that shows where she went, even in the fog.
Use Paranoia to dash onto Evelynn when she is hurt, and finish her before Demon Shade heals her.
Keep Shroud of Darkness up when Fiddlesticks may be hiding nearby; blocking his first ability spoils his fear.
Break away from Fiddlesticks' Bountiful Harvest early; he heals from the damage and hits hardest at the end.
Use Duskbringer to run out of range of Fiddlesticks when he lands Reap; the speed on the trail helps you escape.
Use Paranoia to dive Fiddlesticks; his vision of you shrinks, and the dash cannot be stopped by crowd control.
Cast Shroud of Darkness just before Graves fires End of the Line or Smoke Screen; the shield blocks the next enemy ability and speeds up your attacks.
Use Paranoia to dash onto Graves when he is away from allies. Cast Shroud of Darkness during the dash so a spell shield is up when you land.
Graves' Collateral Damage and Quickdraw can break your Paranoia dash if he uses them mid-flight, so expect him to try. Use Unspeakable Horror once you land.
Stay on Graves with Unspeakable Horror so the tether holds; if it breaks, he gets away before the fear lands. Use Duskbringer to close the gap first.
Fight Graves in the smoke with care: leaving the cloud ends its effect right away, so step out instead of fighting blind.
Cast Shroud of Darkness just as Gwen's Needlework or Snip Snip! is about to land; blocking it speeds up your attacks.
Do not throw Duskbringer or Unspeakable Horror at Gwen while she is in Hallowed Mist; she cannot be targeted from outside it.
Wait for Gwen to leave Hallowed Mist, since it follows her only once, then start the fight with Unspeakable Horror.
Stay in melee range while Unspeakable Horror ticks so the tether holds and she is feared, then chase her down.
Fight Gwen before she has landed several attacks; she needs them to build up her damage.
Use Paranoia to jump onto Gwen when she is out of position. Do not dash while she is in Hallowed Mist; it blocks the dash.
Hold Shroud of Darkness for Hecarim's Onslaught of Shadows or Devastating Charge setup; it blocks the next enemy Ability and speeds your attacks.
Hecarim is sturdy when he fights near allies and enemies, so use Unspeakable Horror on him when he is alone and you can keep the tether unbroken.
Use Paranoia to find Hecarim in the jungle, then dash onto him when he is away from his team.
Throw Duskbringer at Hecarim before you trade; the trail speeds you up and adds attack damage while you fight on it.
Hold Shroud of Darkness for Rootcaller; it blocks the vine and the root, and your Attack Speed goes up.
Use Paranoia when Ivern is away from his team, then dash to him. Daisy and his allies can't help if they can't see you coming.
Don't chase Ivern alone when Daisy is out; her third hit on you knocks you up.
Hit Ivern with Unspeakable Horror and stay attached; if the tether holds, he is feared and you run at him faster.
Ivern's Triggerseed slows when it bursts. Step out of its area before it goes off.
Press Shroud of Darkness when Jarvan IV goes for Dragon Strike or Cataclysm; the shield blocks it and speeds up your attacks.
Keep out of the line between Jarvan IV and his Demacian Standard, or Dragon Strike will knock you up.
Hold Unspeakable Horror until Jarvan IV has no easy way out, then stay on him so the tether holds and he is feared.
Use Paranoia's dash to reach Jarvan IV from far away. Cataclysm's walls will not stop the dash.
Use Duskbringer to chase or to escape when Jarvan IV is on you. Its trail gives you speed.
Do not auto-attack Jax while he is in Counter Strike. Your attacks are dodged and he stuns you when it ends.
Use Shroud of Darkness when Jax jumps in; it blocks his Leap Strike and speeds up your attacks.
Break the Unspeakable Horror tether only if you must. Make Jax stand still, and he is feared and slowed when it ends.
Fight Jax in short bursts. Step away so he cannot keep attacking and build Relentless Assault.
Keep Shroud of Darkness ready for Jayce's Thundering Blow or Shock Blast; blocking one also boosts your Attack Speed.
Cast Unspeakable Horror on Jayce and stay close so the tether holds; he will be feared if it isn't broken.
Use Duskbringer to land a hit and gain speed on its trail, so you can catch Jayce when he tries to kite you.
Cast Paranoia before a gank so Jayce sees less and has trouble spotting you, then dash onto him once you are close.
Dive Karthus with Paranoia when you can; he has no escape or stun, and it can't be stopped by crowd control.
Hit Karthus with Unspeakable Horror and stay on him; if the tether holds, he is feared and cannot cast well.
Turn on Shroud of Darkness as Karthus casts at you; it blocks his Lay Waste or Wall of Pain and speeds up your attacks.
Move away from Karthus's corpse after you kill him; Death Defied lets him keep casting for a short time.
Lay Waste hits harder on a lone target, so stay near minions or allies when you are in his range.
Hold Shroud of Darkness for Kayn's Umbral Trespass. Cast on a spell shield, it fails and goes on full cooldown, so he wastes his big engage.
Raise Shroud of Darkness when Kayn swings Blade's Reach at you. A block also boosts your Attack Speed.
Use Unspeakable Horror on Kayn and stay close so the tether holds. If it holds, he is feared and you run at him faster.
Kayn can slip into walls with Shadow Step to escape. Hit him with Duskbringer first, since his trail shows where he runs.
Paranoia's dash tracks Kayn even if he escapes through terrain. Recast it to finish him when he is low.
Hold Shroud of Darkness for Taste Their Fear or Void Spike when Kha'Zix goes for you; blocking one ability also boosts your Attack Speed.
Stay near your allies, minions or a turret when Kha'Zix is around. Taste Their Fear hurts far less against targets that are not isolated.
Use Paranoia in a fight to cut the enemy's vision, then dash onto Kha'Zix when he is exposed and without his Leap.
Land Unspeakable Horror and stay on him so the tether holds. He is feared if it is not broken, and a Leap will break it.
Throw Duskbringer onto him to leave a trail you can follow. It shows where he went, even in fog.
Use Paranoia when you are ready to dash onto Kindred; she is fragile and dies fast once you land on her.
Turn on Shroud of Darkness as you dash in, so her Mounting Dread or Dance of Arrows is blocked.
Hold Unspeakable Horror until she has used her dash, then fear her and chase; she cannot easily get away.
Do not dive into Lamb's Respite; nobody inside can die. Wait for it to end, then attack.
Throw Duskbringer at her to catch up; her dusk trail speeds you and shows where she went.
Hold Shroud of Darkness for Sonic Wave; blocking it stops the dash too and gives you extra Attack Speed.
Lee Sin's Dragon's Rage is blocked by Shroud of Darkness, so time it as he starts the kick.
Lee Sin is weak to magic damage, so use Unspeakable Horror on him in a fight; if the tether holds, he is feared and you can catch him.
Use Paranoia to dive Lee Sin when he is low; Shroud of Darkness during the dash guards you from his answer.
Aim Duskbringer along his path in the jungle; the trail speeds you up and shows where he went.
Cast Shroud of Darkness just before Lillia's Watch Out! Eep! or Swirlseed lands; it blocks the hit and speeds up your attacks.
Hold Shroud of Darkness for Lilting Lullaby. The shield blocks the sleep warning, so Lillia loses her big fight tool.
Lillia is hard to catch, so use Unspeakable Horror on her and stay close until the tether finishes and she is feared.
Use Paranoia to dash onto Lillia when she is away from her team. The dash cannot be stopped by crowd control.
Throw Duskbringer at Lillia as she runs; the trail gives you speed to chase her.
Cast Unspeakable Horror on Master Yi and stay close until the tether finishes, so he gets feared. His Highlander does not stop the fear.
Turn on Shroud of Darkness when Master Yi is about to use Alpha Strike. It blocks the Ability and speeds up your attacks.
Paranoia's dash cannot be stopped by crowd control. Use it to reach Master Yi when he is farming far from his team.
Hit Master Yi hard while he is healing with Meditate, so he spends mana and gets no free recovery.
Hold Shroud of Darkness for Wukong's Nimbus Strike or Cyclone; the shield blocks it and speeds up your attacks.
Use Paranoia's dash to jump on Wukong when he is alone, then fight him before his stacking armor builds up.
Land Unspeakable Horror and stay on Wukong so the tether holds. He is feared if it is not broken.
Hit the real Wukong after he uses Warrior Trickster. Wait a moment before you commit your abilities.
Use Duskbringer to chase Wukong or to escape his Cyclone. His trail lets you run faster.
Keep Shroud of Darkness ready for Naafiri's Hounds' Pursuit; it blocks the dash damage and leaves her wasting her biggest ability.
Use Shroud of Darkness against Darkin Daggers too; the shield blocks the blades and the bleed.
Hit Naafiri with Unspeakable Horror and keep close so she cannot break the tether. Feared, she can't fight back.
Duskbringer is a long-range line. Use it to catch Naafiri after her Eviscerate, then chase on the trail.
Use Umbra Blades on Naafiri and her packmates together; one swing hits everything around her and heals you.
Cast Shroud of Darkness when you see Nidalee aim Javelin Toss at you; it blocks the javelin and speeds up your attacks.
Raise Shroud of Darkness before her Bushwhack or Pounce lands; the shield blocks one enemy ability, so don't waste it early.
Walk up and use Unspeakable Horror when she is in cougar form. Stay on her until the tether ends and she is feared.
Use Paranoia to dash onto Nidalee when she is out of position. Her Pounce is blocked by Shroud of Darkness if you time it.
Throw Duskbringer at her in a fight. It deals damage and leaves a trail that shows where she runs, even in the fog.
Hold Shroud of Darkness for Biggest Snowball Ever! or Absolute Zero, since blocking either wastes their strongest ability.
Use Paranoia to jump onto Nunu when he starts channeling Absolute Zero or the snowball. Both can be interrupted.
Turn sharply to dodge Biggest Snowball Ever!. It turns slowly, so running in a straight line will not save you.
Fear Nunu with Unspeakable Horror and stay on the tether. If it breaks, you lose the fear.
Cast Shroud of Darkness just as Pantheon leaps in with Shield Vault; it blocks the stun and speeds up your attacks.
Shroud of Darkness also blocks the Comet Spear thrown from range, so use it when you see him hold the spear.
Do not attack Pantheon from the front while Aegis Assault is up. Wait for it to end or hit him from the side or behind.
Use Unspeakable Horror on Pantheon when his stun is spent, and stay on him so the tether holds and he is feared.
Paranoia's dash is blocked by spell shields, but Pantheon has none. Dash onto him when he is low and cannot stop you.
Keep your distance from Pantheon when he is channeling Grand Starfall, and use Paranoia to hunt his team while he lands.
Hold Shroud of Darkness for Supreme Display of Talent or Audacity; blocking it wastes her key ability and speeds up your attacks.
Start the fight with Unspeakable Horror and stay on her. Her escapes are short, and the fear only lands if the tether stays unbroken.
Use Paranoia to dash onto her when she is out of position. The dash cannot be stopped by crowd control, so she cannot easily shake it off.
Hit her with Duskbringer to leave a trail on her. You get faster and hit harder while following it.
Do not pick fights with Rammus while Defensive Ball Curl is up; your attacks hurt you. Wait until it ends.
Use Shroud of Darkness to block Frenzying Taunt when Rammus walks up to you.
Use Duskbringer to keep your distance from Rammus. Powerball is his main way to catch you.
Use Paranoia on his teammates rather than on Rammus; a tank takes your damage easily, and the recast is better spent on a squishy target.
Hold Shroud of Darkness for Rek'Sai's Void Rush or Furious Bite; the shield blocks either and your attack speed goes up.
Throw Duskbringer at Rek'Sai to follow her; the trail speeds you up and lets you chase her down.
Cast Unspeakable Horror on Rek'Sai and stay close so the tether holds. If it holds, she is feared and slowed.
Fight Rek'Sai when her Fury is low; a full Fury makes her Furious Bite hit much harder.
Press Shroud of Darkness just as Rengar throws Bola Strike or leaps in with his empowered ability; the shield blocks it and speeds up your attacks.
Shroud of Darkness also blocks Rengar's Battle Roar, so use it when he is about to burst you.
Use Unspeakable Horror on Rengar when he is stuck on you; if the tether holds he is feared and you chase him down fast.
Fight Rengar while his Ferocity is low, and play safe near brush where he can leap onto you.
Cast Duskbringer through Rengar to leave a trail; it speeds you up and shows where he goes, even if he is camouflaged.
Hold Paranoia's dash for Rengar when he is low or alone; it can't be stopped by crowd control and tracks him down.
Hold Shroud of Darkness for Glacial Prison or Arctic Assault; the shield blocks the next enemy ability, and a block gives you extra Attack Speed.
Use Unspeakable Horror on Sejuani only when you can stay on her. The fear only lands if the tether holds, so a charge or dash can break it.
Fight Sejuani early, before she has allies and levels to build a tanky team around her. Her tank body makes long solo fights hard for you.
Use Paranoia to dive her backline when she is away from her team. Cast Shroud of Darkness during the dash so a stun can't stop you.
Save Shroud of Darkness for Shaco's engage. It blocks his next ability, so he may waste Two-Shiv Poison or Hallucinate.
Duskbringer's trail shows where Shaco went, even when he is invisible. Use it to find him after Deceive.
Walk carefully into bushes and camp paths, since Shaco hides boxes there. Take a different route when you suspect one.
Feared enemies make you faster toward them. Use Unspeakable Horror and chase down a Shaco who is feared or fleeing.
Use Paranoia at level 6 to dash onto Shaco. Cast Shroud of Darkness first so his reply gets blocked.
Hold Shroud of Darkness for Shyvana's Molten Burst or Dragon's Descent; blocking it also boosts your Attack Speed.
Throw Duskbringer at Shyvana to chase her down or to run away; the trail gives you speed and follows her.
Use Unspeakable Horror on Shyvana and keep close so the tether holds; she is feared when it lasts.
Gank when Shyvana is low on Dragon Fury, then use Paranoia to jump onto her before she can turn into a dragon.
Hold Shroud of Darkness for Skarner's Impale or Ixtal's Impact; blocking either wastes his key cooldown and speeds up your attacks.
Throw Duskbringer at Skarner when he is chasing or fleeing; the trail gives you speed and bonus damage to stick to him.
Use Unspeakable Horror and stay on him so the tether holds; once he is feared he can't fight back, so you can hit him freely.
Don't brawl for long against Skarner, because his attacks stack Quaking and hurt more over time. Burst him, then step away.
Use Paranoia to reach Skarner or his carries when he is out of position. The dash keeps going even if he slows you.
Keep Shroud of Darkness ready for Abduct or Chain Lash; blocking it wastes his key ability and speeds up your attacks.
Cast Shroud of Darkness before you dash in with Paranoia; Sylas may waste his Hijack or Abduct on the shield.
Use Unspeakable Horror when he is low; if he stays tethered he is feared and cannot fight back.
Sylas can heal with Kingslayer, so finish him quickly once he is hurt, using Paranoia to reach him.
Paranoia is a strong ultimate to dive with, but Sylas can steal it with Hijack, so fight him when Hijack is down.
Hold Shroud of Darkness for Talon's Noxian Diplomacy or Rake when he comes at you; blocking it also boosts your Attack Speed.
Use Unspeakable Horror on Talon when he is close and stay on him. If he can't break the tether, he is feared.
Throw Duskbringer at Talon to leave a trail that shows where he went, even through fog or invisibility, then chase along it.
Use Paranoia when Talon roams or ganks. It cuts his vision, and you can dash onto him once you find him.
Fight Talon in the jungle when you have Umbra Blades ready; the heal helps you win a long trade.
Pull Trundle away from his Frozen Domain; he is far weaker outside it. Do not fight him inside it.
Hold Shroud of Darkness for Subjugate; blocking it saves you from the drain and speeds up your attacks.
Leave Pillar of Ice quickly; it slows you, so do not chase through it.
Use Duskbringer for your own speed when Trundle runs, and use Unspeakable Horror when he cannot easily break away from the tether.
Hold Shroud of Darkness for Blazing Stampede's attack. The shield blocks the stun when Udyr jumps on you.
Use Unspeakable Horror on Udyr early in a fight. If he stays tethered, he is feared and slowed and you can hit him freely.
Throw Duskbringer at Udyr's path when he runs, then chase on the trail. You move faster and hit harder while on it.
Use Paranoia to dash onto Udyr once he is hurt. Dodging the dash is hard for him, but he can block it with Iron Mantle's shield.
Cast Shroud of Darkness just as Vi lands Cease and Desist on you; it blocks the dash and wastes her ultimate.
Raise Shroud of Darkness when Vi charges Vault Breaker at you; the shield blocks the punch and boosts your Attack Speed.
Use Unspeakable Horror on Vi and keep her in range so the tether holds; she is feared when it finishes.
Do not trade long auto-attack fights with Vi; her third hit cuts your Armor and speeds her up. Use Umbra Blades and leave.
Use Duskbringer to chase Vi when she runs, or to get away when she is charging at you.
Hold Shroud of Darkness for Viego's Spectral Maw; it blocks the stun and speeds up your attacks.
Use Shroud of Darkness before Viego's Heartbreaker lands; a spell shield blocks the spell, and it is his strongest burst.
Hit Viego with Unspeakable Horror and stay on him so the tether holds. He is feared if it is not broken.
Use Duskbringer to chase Viego through the Mist trail and to leave a fight that is going badly.
Cast Paranoia when Viego's team is spread out. The dash goes to the enemy you pick, and Viego loses sight of the map.
Hold Shroud of Darkness for Volibear's Thundering Smash; blocking it also stops the stun and leaves you with extra Attack Speed.
Shroud of Darkness also blocks Sky Splitter and Frenzied Maul, so time it for his first big move in a fight.
Step out of the Sky Splitter circle while it lands; it is slow to arrive and only slows and hurts those inside.
Use Paranoia to dash onto Volibear when he is low or away from allies; the dash cannot be stopped by crowd control.
Land Unspeakable Horror and stay close so the tether holds; if he walks out of range, the fear is lost.
Time Shroud of Darkness for Warwick's Infinite Duress; blocking the leap wastes his ultimate.
Do not let Warwick sit low on health in a long fight; Eternal Hunger heals him more the lower he gets. Burst him or leave.
Stay healthy when you scout near Warwick; Blood Hunt makes him fast and attack faster against hurt champions.
Use Unspeakable Horror and stay in range so the tether lasts; the fear pushes Warwick away, but he ends his own Primal Howl with a fear too.
Time Shroud of Darkness for Audacious Charge or Wind Becomes Lightning; blocking one also boosts your Attack Speed.
Use Unspeakable Horror from the edge of its range and keep your distance, so Xin Zhao's charge can't easily break the tether.
Avoid fighting Xin Zhao when his Three Talon Strike is ready; the knock up and fast cooldowns beat you in a long trade.
Do not dash in with Paranoia while Xin Zhao has Crescent Guard ready; his sweep punishes you on arrival. Pick other targets, or bait it first.
Hold Shroud of Darkness for Zac's Stretching Strikes or Elastic Slingshot; it blocks the next enemy ability and boosts your Attack Speed.
Step away from the goo chunks Zac sheds. Enemies who walk over a chunk destroy it, so crush them to deny his healing.
Use Paranoia's dash to jump on Zac only when his Cell Division is down; otherwise you must kill all of his bloblets.
Cast Unspeakable Horror on Zac and stay close so the tether does not break. Chase him once he is feared.
Dodge Stretching Strikes by moving sideways. Duskbringer lets you close the gap or run away quickly if it lands.
Hold Shroud of Darkness for Zed's Death Mark; the shield blocks it, so he wastes his best spell and you get faster attacks.
Zed's Razor Shuriken is blocked by Shroud of Darkness, so use it when he throws one at you.
Use Paranoia to dash onto Zed when he is out of position, since crowd control cannot stop the dash. Cast Shroud of Darkness during the dash for safety.
Use Unspeakable Horror on Zed when he has spent his Living Shadow. He has little room to escape before the fear lands.
Aim Duskbringer at Zed to leave a trail on him. You get faster and hit harder while chasing him along it.
Raise Shroud of Darkness when Zyra aims Grasping Roots or Stranglethorns at you; it blocks the ability and speeds up your attacks.
Dash in with Paranoia when Zyra is far from her allies. Her plants only matter near her seeds, and the dash cannot be stopped by crowd control.
Step over or around her seeds before they grow into plants. Hit Zyra when she has few seeds near her.
Close in with Unspeakable Horror once Zyra has used Grasping Roots. Her fear window is then safe and she has little left to stop you.
Use Duskbringer to cover ground quickly when you chase her or run away. Its trail gives you speed and attack damage.
